exposure: time interval between sonographic weight estimation and delivery
outcome: accuracy of ultrasound-based fetal weight estimation
deviation between estimated and actual birth weight
cohort: The study analyzed medical records of 331 fetuses from induced labors between January and June 2021.
finding: A shorter time interval between sonographic weight estimation and delivery (less than 7 days), high maternal BMI (> 30 kg/m2), maternal age, neonatal weight, and neonatal length were significantly associated with the accuracy of ultrasound-based fetal weight estimation.
birth_weight: The mean actual birth weight was 3,508 ± 508 g.
